sn1.46:1.1: Accharāgaṇasaṅghuṭṭhaṃ || pisācagaṇasevitaṃ || vanan-tam mohanaṃ nāma || kathaṃ yātrā bhavissatīti || ||
sn1.46:2.1: Ujuko nāma so maggo || abhayā nāma sā disā || ratho akujano nāma || dhammacakkehi saṃyuto || ||
sn1.46:3.1: Hirī tassa apālambo || saty-assa parivāraṇam || dhammāhaṃ sārathiṃ brūmi || sammādiṭṭhipure javaṃ || ||
sn1.46:4.1: Yassa etādisaṃ yānaṃ || itthiyā purisassa vā || sa ve etena yānena || nibbānass-eva santike ti || ||
